title: Lost Mary BM600 Triple Melon Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Triple Melon Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods blend three varieties of Melon for a layered fruit flavour that’s both sweet and refreshing. Juicy Watermelon forms the base, with the richer sweetness of Honeydew and the smooth lift of Cantaloupe adding balance and depth. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on usage. Designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, they provide a satisfying experience with no need for refilling or coil changes. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods are quick and clean to install. Simply click a pod into the device and enjoy consistent flavour and vapour with every puff.
